name: Délina
text: Délina forwarded the note from the pool desk, the family swim moves to sunday at ten n the small pool stays closed for the filter change

name: Rasolofo
text: Rasolofo passed this on from the depot, the pallet of tiles arrives friday n needs signing for at the yard gate, the driver will ring twenty minutes ahead so keep the number handy

name: Anthonie Thongchai Höglin
text: Anthonie Thongchai Höglin sent this across from the grants office, the community fund window opens on monday n closes sharp at noon on the 30th. Applications need two quotes and a photo of the site. The panel meets in the first week of the following month so get them in early. Late entries are not accepted.

name: Cyrillus Gülal
text: Cyrillus Gülal forwarded the message from the coastguard post, the flag system changes on monday and the green flag now means swimming is supervised

name: Ratana
text: Ratana sent this on from the estate office, the gritting route is changing this winter so the top road gets done first n the cul de sacs last, salt is stored in the two bins by the green

name: Sahinkaya
text: Sahinkaya passed the note from the swimming pool along, the lane swim times change from the 3rd n the booking app opens a week ahead. Members get priority for the first hour. The lessons move to the teaching pool and the calendar is updated at the desk.

name: Sonya Brus Distino
text: Sonya Brus Distino forwarded this from the church office, the bell practice moves to wednesday evenings while the tower repairs run, so the usual thursday is off

name: Hayato Jeyapalan Matejovic
text: Hayato Jeyapalan Matejovic sent this on from the sports centre, the badminton courts are being resurfaced over half term so all bookings move to the school hall, the times stay the same

name: Evghenia
text: Evghenia forwarded the note from the housing office, the bin store key is changing and the new one is on the fob you already have. The collection day stays tuesday but the lorry comes earlier so put bins out the night before. Bulky waste collections must now be booked online. A leaflet is coming to every flat.

name: Diliet
text: Diliet forwarded this from the cafe, the quiz night moves to the last thursday of the month n teams are capped at six, sign up on the board

name: De Marinis
text: De Marinis passed this across from the front desk, the visitor sign in tablets are being updated on friday morning so use the paper book until noon, badges still need returning at the end of each visit

name: Chorna Heijmen
text: Chorna Heijmen sent this on from the planning group, the consultation on the new cycle lane closes on the 21st and only forty responses have come in. The route map is on the website and paper copies are at the library. If the numbers stay low the scheme may be dropped. Please share with anyone who uses that road.

name: Tinet
text: Tinet forwarded the note from the tool library, the hedge trimmer is back in stock n the strimmer is booked out until saturday, reserve online

name: Seniye
text: Seniye opened the meeting with the car park resurfacing and the contractor quote came in under budget. The work goes ahead in august and the bays by the wall stay open. Barrier repairs are included. The invoice is due on completion.

name: Jupin
text: Jupin chaired the session and the first item was the storage audit, which found the archive room at capacity. A digitisation pilot was approved for the oldest files and the shelving stays until spring. Two new cabinets were ordered for the annex. The shredding contract renews in october and quotes will be sought.

name: Thabisa Agmir Ceglie
text: Thabisa Agmir Ceglie ran the huddle and confirmed the pallet count is back in line. Two damaged crates were credited.

name: de Marzo
text: de Marzo took the chair and the fire risk assessment was reviewed line by line. The two open actions close this week and the extinguisher tags are being renewed. Training for the new starters runs on the 9th. A full drill is planned for october.

name: Sivamoorthy
text: Sivamoorthy opened the meeting with the results of the parent survey and the headline was later start times. A working group will look at the bus schedule before any change. The uniform swap shop is staying open twice a week. Feedback will be shared at the next meeting. Nothing is decided yet.

name: Shefkinaze
text: Shefkinaze opened the meeting and the june minutes were approved without changes. The pond clearance date is set for the 11th.

name: Briyan Mühlburger
text: Briyan Mühlburger led the briefing and the night shift handover was signed as complete. The conveyor belt service is booked for the quiet shift and spares are in the cage. Two operators need refresher training on the new scanner.

name: Aglaja Drahoslava
text: Aglaja Drahoslava welcomed the new trustees and ran through the safeguarding policy first. The hall hire rates were reviewed and stay the same for the coming year. A grant application for the kitchen refit is being prepared by two volunteers. The annual report is drafted and needs a proof read. The next meeting falls on the 4th.

name: Alex
text: Alex opened the session with the delivery backlog and the two missed drops from friday. The courier account is under review.

name: Corsin
text: Corsin took the minutes at the library friends meeting and the book sale raised four hundred. The reading challenge prizes arrived and are being packed. The summer opening hours were agreed with two late nights. Volunteers are still needed for the return trolley.

name: Shanderasegaram Kahnemouyi Zgolli
text: Shanderasegaram Kahnemouyi Zgolli chaired the residents meeting and parking topped the agenda again. The permit scheme has cut commuter parking by half according to the last count. Two disabled bays are being added by the pharmacy. The grass cutting contract goes out to tender and the committee wants a local firm. The next meeting is in september.

name: Masculine SA
text: Masculine SA chaired the huddle and the missing delivery from tuesday was traced to the wrong bay. It is being returned this afternoon.

name: Terracini
text: Terracini opened the meeting with the swimming gala budget and the entry fees cover the pool hire. Ribbons and medals came in under the estimate. The date clashes with the football final so a vote moved it a week. Marshals are still needed.

name: Sejdullah
text: Fwd: gritting update, the depot has changed the priority roads and the hill by the surgery now gets done first. Sejdullah has the new route map printed if you want a copy. The salt bins are being refilled this week. Send any missed streets to the office.

name: Gombay
text: Fwd: pool boiler, the boiler is fixed n the showers are hot again, Gombay confirmed the part was still under warranty so no charge this time

name: Paré Friden
text: Forwarded from the groundskeeper, the pitch lines are being repainted on thursday so the under 12s session moves to the all weather. Paré Friden checked the booking and the slot is free after four. The goals stay in place.

name: von Hirschheydt
text: Fwd: road closure, the resurfacing on the high street starts monday and runs for three weeks. Access stays open from the market end and the bus stops move to the square. von Hirschheydt has posted the diversion map on the board. Deliveries before nine are allowed through with a pass.

name: Esra
text: Fwd: parcels, the courier dropped three boxes at the wrong unit and Esra walked them over, the labels were all ours so its sorted

name: N'guessan
text: Forwarded from the allotment office, the rent invoices went out late so the deadline moves to the 30th. N'guessan checked the plot list and four have changed hands. Direct debits are unaffected.

name: Kanagarajah Gussmann Primi
text: Fwd: exam timetable, the hall exams move to the sports pavilion because the heating is being replaced. Kanagarajah Gussmann Primi has the seating plan and the extra invigilators are booked. Morning sessions start an hour later than planned. The accessibility shuttle runs from the main gate.

name: De Sandre
text: Fwd: sample trays, the lab trays came back unwashed again, De Sandre rang the prep room and they will redo the batch before friday

name: Adeyemi
text: Forwarded from the transport office, the friday shuttle is cancelled because of the depot inspection. Adeyemi has booked two taxis from the pool instead and the fares go on the account. The usual service returns monday.

name: Verploegh
text: Fwd: boiler room, the inspection found the pressure valve needs replacing and the parts are on order. Verploegh has booked the engineer for tuesday and the heating stays on for now. The log book must be kept up to date. A follow up check happens in six weeks.

name: Lajana Gospava
text: Fwd: kitchen deep clean, the extractor filters failed the spot check, Lajana Gospava has ordered replacements n the clean is redone sunday morning

name: al Assaf
text: Forwarded from the welfare office, the food bank collection point moves to the church porch from monday. al Assaf has updated the posters and the van will still come at ten on wednesdays. Donations of tinned goods are most needed.

name: Muhumed
text: Notes from the porters meeting, the key audit found six unreturned sets and reminders go out friday. Muhumed is rekeying the east store and the new keys are on the hook. The visitor log moves to the tablet. Fire door checks continue weekly and the training slots are posted on the board.

name: Cotten
text: The workshop group met and the lathe needs a new belt, Cotten priced one at 22 and it is on order. Safety guards were checked.

name: Ahmed-Amine Ganesathas
text: The rehearsal notes say the lighting cue list needs rebuilding and Ahmed-Amine Ganesathas offered to do it over the weekend. The hired desk arrives thursday. Costumes are nearly all fitted and the last two are pinned.

name: Emaad Gorgolini
text: Notes from the finance subgroup, the reserve is healthy and the projector fund reached its target early. Emaad Gorgolini suggested holding the surplus for the roof work and the group agreed. The audit fee is unchanged this year. Next update in june and the accounts were signed off.

name: Sathiyaseelan
text: The band practice notes are short, the drum kit stays in the hall and Sathiyaseelan will bring the spare cymbals next week. Doors stay locked.

name: Ragnoli
text: The garden club notes say the water butts are full and the compost order arrives friday. Ragnoli will run the seed swap table at the fete. The raised bed timber was donated.

name: Kwesi Winiker
text: Notes from the youth club planning, the summer programme is nearly full and the climbing trip has a waiting list. Kwesi Winiker is checking the minibus licence and the risk forms go out next week. Two new volunteers are doing their inductions. The grant claim was submitted last night.

name: Dalin Halters Kabongo
text: The quiz league notes are simple, the thursday slot is confirmed and Dalin Halters Kabongo has the new question packs ready. Entry stays at two pounds.

name: Jane
text: The committee notes record that the bench replacement was approved and Jane has the plaque wording ready. The old bench goes to the workshop. Two more donations came in for the hedge fund.

name: Bauta
text: Notes from the beekeeping group, the new hives are sited away from the footpath and the swarm kit is by the shed door. Bauta will order the winter feed and the fondant goes on in september. The honey crop was better than last year. Members can borrow the extractor.

name: Lei Jenoshan
text: The karaoke night notes confirm the room is booked and Lei Jenoshan is bringing the speaker. Song sheets are printed.

name: Omoregie van Strien
text: The clean up notes from saturday record 14 bags collected and Omoregie van Strien has booked the tip slot for tuesday. Gloves were donated by the hardware shop. The next litter pick is the 26th.
